annotations.title: Ranked list of a "top 100" or "most famous" page

description: The ranked items of one of this website's ranking pages, exactly as the page lists them: the 100 most famous paintings, artists, museums or articles, the most famous paintings of an art movement, a period or a subject, the most famous artists of a movement or a country, the most famous paintings of one artist, the famous artists of one museum. Use it for "what is number 33?", "who is first?", "which ones are in the top ten?", or to name the works of such a list. Give page_url (the address of the ranking page: the one the person is on, or a link a tool returned), or list_name for the four general lists (top_100_paintings, top_100_artists, top_100_museums, top_100_articles). rank_from / rank_to choose the ranks (default 1-20, at most 50 per call). Returns list_title, list_url, total (how many items the list holds) and items: rank, name, url (its page on this website), and when the page gives them by (the artist), year and note. not_a_ranked_list_page for any other page: use the search tools then.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

list_name.description: One of the general lists, instead of page_url.

page_url.description: Address of a ranking page of this website.
